request.query:
mutation CreateService($name: String!, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $type: String, $repo: String, $image: String, $registryCredentialId: String, $branch: String, $rootDir: String, $runtime: String, $buildCommand: String, $startCommand: String, $dockerfilePath: String, $buildFilter: BuildFilterInput, $plan: String, $autoDeploy: Boolean, $schedule: String, $command: String, $publishPath: String, $port: Int, $envVars: [EnvVarInput], $secretFiles: [SecretFileInput]) {
  createService(
    name: $name
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    type: $type
    repo: $repo
    image: $image
    registryCredentialId: $registryCredentialId
    branch: $branch
    rootDir: $rootDir
    runtime: $runtime
    buildCommand: $buildCommand
    startCommand: $startCommand
    dockerfilePath: $dockerfilePath
    buildFilter: $buildFilter
    plan: $plan
    autoDeploy: $autoDeploy
    schedule: $schedule
    command: $command
    publishPath: $publishPath
    port: $port
    envVars: $envVars
    secretFiles: $secretFiles
  ) {
    id
    name
    type
    phase
    projectId
    environmentId
    registryCredentialId
    latestDeployId
    __typename
  }
}

limits: All ordering/cancel failures use controlled return latency on genuine native file reads; no claim of natural frequency or that small local files are normally slow.

The initial V1 selection gap is about7ms; it is supporting evidence and the one actual wrong save/runtime followed it. The primary desktop/mobile V2 selections are more than1.2s apart and independently reproduce the same incorrect preview/imported draft; they were not separately deployed.

A reload encountered the legitimate beforeunload guard; it was accepted to continue. The page can restore its unsaved editor draft. The import dialog starts empty in the replay; no claim about whole-editor draft discard is made.

After fresh load, the untouched KEEP textarea is empty because its value is masked, not because it was cleared. Recovery's patch omits KEEP, and both independent saved-value reads/public responses preserve keep-unchanged.

The timing probes restore the native function reference in finally. Closeout also removes the resulting own File.prototype.text shadow when it equals Blob.prototype.text; no overrides or held reads remain.

Service types other than web, static/Render aliases, group create/edit flows, manual edits during a pending read, same-name files, stale errors, external parent close/unmount and submit during a pending replacement were not live-probed.
No secret-file upload, parser rewrite, API contract change, paid resource, foreign mutation, security test or product fix. Source serving bundle was not independently mapped to HEAD.
